# held-straggler sweep; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Grand Isle, Official Return of Votes, March 3, 2026 (certified): Ronnie Bushway was elected Moderator, 367 votes. The return's 'Ronnie' is the selectboard member Ron Bushway (diminutive) -- the same person record is reused. The lister contest on the same return named no candidate and produced only scattered write-ins, so that seat stays open.
